change_summary: The journal's editors published an expression of concern about the paper because they have been made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article. The matter is still being looked into, and the editors will update readers when more information is available. The notice does not say which data, figures or results the concerns are about, while the paper's data include immobility times (Figure 3) and bacterial counts (Figure 4). The paper's main finding is that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test (Figure 3).
evaluation: In the Discussion, the draft cites Lopez and Chen [8] as having shown reduced activity in recipient mice, as support for a causal role of gut bacteria in depressive behaviour, and says its own proposal builds on this finding. The paper reports that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test (Figure 3). The editors' expression of concern says they have been made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article, but the notice does not say which data, figures or results the concerns are about. The matter is still being looked into, with no outcome given yet.
recommendation: The journal's editors published an expression of concern about the paper, and the editors have been made aware of concerns about some of the data reported in the article, but the notice does not say which data, figures or results the concerns are about. The draft cites Lopez and Chen [8] as having shown reduced activity in recipient mice, as support for a causal role of gut bacteria in depressive behaviour, and the draft says its own proposal builds on this finding. Hedge that sentence in the Discussion, cite the expression of concern, and don't build new work on this result until the journal's investigation is resolved; it's worth raising the proposal's reliance on it with your co-authors or supervisor. The matter is still being looked into, with no outcome given yet; this assistant keeps tracking the paper, so a retraction or other outcome would raise a new alert.
